title: Source package quality and maintained method interfaces
summary: Extend existing Ruff and partial mypy checks to the whole source package, with typed service signatures, a shared storage boundary and one interface for the two maintained experiment methods.
decision_provenance: The user requested modern static checking, linting, formatting and practical abstractions. The assistant selected strict package-wide mypy, additional Ruff rules, the storage extraction and the ExperimentMethod protocol; these implementation choices were not separately recorded as user decisions.
findings: Ruff already covered source and tests; mypy originally named only four source modules.
Preparation, scoring, replay and viewing dispatch was repeated across the CLI and workflow for landmark and portable-package methods.
Extensible research documents retain runtime schema validators; static checking does not certify arbitrary JSON fields or optional model-runtime internals.
The copied reproduction runner and segmentation adapter retain their standalone execution contracts.

followups.summary: Audited the user-pasted review of 24e4de7 against clean HEAD 03802612180df233f353ab17bb58dafde82c9fcb. These are assistant recommendations; the user requested an audit, not implementation approval.
findings: A temporary git archive of HEAD, without local medical assets, reproduces med brief check exiting 1 with wsi-camelyon-search: missing overview visual. Scanning every composed entry identifies exactly five affected entries: wsi-camelyon-search, wsi-hiesd-map, wsi-hiesd-patches, wsi-hubmap-inventory and wsi-tiger-context.

Missing-image text and a synthetic required-overview fallback regression already exist. Repair authored WSI overview definitions and add real-catalog clean-checkout coverage. An explicit resolved-visual value can remove HTML inspection later; it is not required to repair the blocker.

collect still consumes Document binding and launcher receipts, overrides imported execution state for terminal partial results, and projects the evaluation inline. Typed binding and resolved observation values plus a named pure evaluation projection fit the current architecture. Preserve wire bytes, ownership precedence, proof and identity formulas, partial results, unchanged collection and A-to-B-to-A observations.

Legacy playback sets playing false before render, while animated model refresh depends on playing; completion can retain the previous sample. The newer canonical story branch samples absolute frames independently and does not have this specific cache condition. This is a source-level finding, not a browser-reproduced visual defect.

Point remains number[] for both 2D pointer and 3D scene values; primitive point counts and several stage arguments are unconstrained. Introduce tuple-producing constructors and Stage signatures at existing feature boundaries, preserving finite-value and imported mesh validation. Readonly contracts need not force internal numeric accumulators to be immutable.

Scene-family extraction is conditional maintenance, not a current correctness fix. The new route-prefab and canonical story pilot already have separate owners; do not create a second route abstraction or migrate other catalog entries as an audit side effect. Texture error and partial-initialization cleanup remain fault-injection followups, not measured leak claims.
recommended_sequence: Repair all five portable WSI overviews with clearly labeled task-specific conceptual illustrations and retained optional source images; prove both portable build modes from a clean archive.
Fix exact final sampling separately from type migration; add a controlled-clock witness of the final builder arguments and retain story/legacy browser coverage.
Complete collection binding, state and evaluation projection contracts with unchanged baseline fixtures and terminal-partial/identity regressions.
Constrain screen/scene coordinates, primitive cardinalities and stages incrementally; retain geometry, anatomy and browser checks.
Extract only a scene family whose next concrete change benefits from independent ownership.

validation.passed: 68 focused Python tests: Harbor import 16, workflow refinements 24, task briefs 11, medical workflow 17. npm run typecheck and node tests/task_scene_models.cjs passed.
validation.failed_as_expected: Clean archived HEAD med brief check: missing WSI overview; all five affected entries enumerated independently.
validation.not_run: Full make check, portable HTML build, browser UI checks and live GitHub Actions log verification.

authorization.decision: Proceed with the audited fixes and scoped contract refactors.

changes: All five WSI entries have task-specific conceptual overviews using existing illustration kinds and a planar WSI subject. Source images remain optional and visibly unavailable when absent. The real composed catalog is tested with local image access disabled; scene checks now traverse nested collections.

Legacy animated models cache the elapsed time represented by their geometry independently of playback scheduling. A production-hook test with a controlled clock proves pause/resume, the exact 10-second final sample, completed-frame reuse and disposal for three animated output kinds.

CollectionBinding and VerifiedTaskBinding distinguish candidate ownership from matching task proof. ObservationState resolves terminal partial results, and evaluation_from_trial owns persistence projection. The existing dictionary binding API and retained baseline fixtures remain supported.

ScreenPoint, ScenePoint, Segment, Quad and Polygon express coordinate dimensions and primitive cardinalities. Tuple-producing geometry maps and Stage signatures replace loose arrays at scene boundaries; imported anatomy and native route points retain finite-value checks. Scientific coordinates and retained asset bytes remain unchanged.
Scene-family extraction and renderer fault-path hardening remain deferred, as recommended in the audit.

verification.repository: make check PYTHON=python3.12 passed in the shared checkout and in an isolated staged-source snapshot: 166 Python tests, Git-index artifact policy, medical records, docs, strict mypy, generated contracts, Ruff and workflow syntax.
verification.frontend: Frontend build and make js-check passed, including 205 illustration entries, geometry/anatomy checks, exact final sampling and all 792 canonical story states.
verification.portable: Integrated and standalone builds passed from staged sources with only compiled frontend assets under .local; no medical previews were copied. Missing source media remains explicit.
verification.browser: The existing disposable-browser presentation harness passed for 205 briefs, 437 conditions, 284 source records and 118 spatial scenes, including playback/fallback, mobile and nested-path/offline behavior, with no page errors or remote requests. Final WSI wording received a separate standalone browser check and screenshot review for all five entries.
verification.local_artifacts: .local/feedback-refactor-20260925 contains logs, browser reports, WSI screenshots and a standalone HTML preview. These are presentation and software checks, not medical capability evidence.
verification.preservation: Harbor baseline fixtures were not regenerated. Frozen task bytes and scientific results were untouched. Concurrent route-pilot documentation remained separately owned.

followups.reopen_when: The portable overview policy changes, a new collection consumer needs a narrower contract, renderer fault injection exposes a defect, or a concrete family edit justifies extraction. Recheck current source and active ownership.

followups.summary: The user requested architecture and file-structure guidance. The assistant consolidated the existing module and placement summaries into two current guides, checked the architecture against live source, linked contributor and agent entry points, and added the guides to required documentation checks.
followups.reopen_when: Component boundaries, record discovery, canonical file homes or standalone runtime contracts change.

followups.summary: The user requested an audit, fixes and polish against TB3_CODING_STYLE.md and allowed simplifying it into canonical guidance. The assistant reviewed the current checkout and the completed typed-Harbor branch, reused its implementation, and made docs/coding-style.md the maintained guide. Implementation choices below are assistant decisions, not separate user approvals.

prior_work.integration: Applied reviewed code and lockfile changes from the completed local branch without moving branches or changing the shared Git index.

findings: Strict mypy passed at baseline, but Document hid fixed Harbor result fields and task validation returned four positional values. ImportedTrial, typed case/evidence helpers, ParsedCases, ResultState and ValidatedTask now expose those contracts.
Projection previously required a workspace read. project_records now accepts loaded records and a pending review without mutating its inputs; extensible scientific fields remain accepted.
Workflow storage calls now name storage directly. Existing core re-exports remain for other callers.

Historical timestamps remain opaque objects with unchanged truthiness and serialized values. New closed normalized models reject missing/extra fields and unintended coercion; existing research records keep their current validators.
Ten synthetic baseline fixtures pin imported JSON, collected JSON, observation identity, warnings and result states to b7b9717. They are regression witnesses, not medical evidence.
Digest encodings, path policies, standalone reproduction code, generated browser contracts and experiment-local algorithms intentionally retain separate ownership.

review.summary: A follow-up review found that finite-number normalization raised OverflowError for oversized JSON integers. Such rewards and token counts now normalize to unavailable values; the trial remains inspectable with no scoring verdict. Synthetic baseline fixtures were retained unchanged.
review.regressions: Added positive and negative oversized-integer coverage. Tightened baseline assertions to compare serialized values, persisted evaluation text and the complete raw-file inventory.
review.commit_scope: Canonical style guide, typed Harbor and workflow contracts, pure projection, dependencies and their regressions. Prior frontend and architecture-discussion edits remain separately owned.

followups.reopen_when: A maintained consumer needs a narrower record or method-result schema, or a shared scientific primitive has matching semantics and a preservation plan. Broad record migration and universal scoring models remain out of scope.

reopen_when: A third maintained method needs these operations, stable record fields justify stronger schema types, or a runtime dependency can be checked without provisioning model environments.
